He serves as the {{wp|home economics|home economics}} teacher of [[Naranja Academy]]{{sup/9|S}}/[[Uva Academy]]{{sup/9|V}}. ==In the core series games== {{incomplete|section|needs=Section for information regarding their appearance and interactions as a Special Coach at the [[Blueberry Academy]] [[League Club Room]]}} Saguaro’s classes focus on the mechanics of sandwiches and other aspects of picnics. Despite his domestic skills and the fact that many of his Pokémon are on the cuter side, he has a reputation among his students as being cool, stylish, and aloof, which he feels the need to uphold. This prevents him from openly engaging in some of his interests, such as his taste for sweets. He even eats spicy food instead despite not favoring it. In [[Bonds|forming bonds]] with him, he will ask the player to retrieve him some [[Sweet Herba Mystica]]. Upon its delivery, he enjoys it so openly that a student notices, but this doesn’t shatter their admiration of him. This shows him that he can enjoy his interests without worrying. Saguaro has a cameo in [[Dendra]]’s friendship story, where he gives her cooking tips. He also participates in the [[Academy Ace Tournament]]. ===The Indigo Disk=== After completing the main story, Saguaro can be invited to [[Unova]]'s [[Blueberry Academy]] as a special coach, where he may be [[rematch]]ed. ===Pokémon=== Saguaro will {{Tera}}stallize his {{p|Hatterene}} at the first opportunity. ====[[Academy Ace Tournament]] (before catching {{p|Terapagos}})==== {{Party | {{color2|fff|Pokémon Scarlet and Violet|Scarlet and Violet}} |} ==Quotes== {{main|Saguaro/Quotes}} ==In animation== [[File:Saguaro Tyme PPW.png|250px|thumb|Saguaro in [[Pokémon: Paldean Winds]]]] ===Pokémon: Paldean Winds=== Saguaro briefly appeared in ''[[PPW01|Breathe Out]]'', clapping alongside other teachers at [[Ohara]]'s performance. He was briefly seen again in ''[[PPW04|Breathe Together]]'', during Ohara, [[Aliquis]], and [[Hohma]]'s video presenting [[Naranja Academy]]. ====Pokémon==== {| | {{ActivePoké|Saguaro|Pachirisu|0417Pachirisu.png|Electric|size=100px|link=no}} | |} {{-}} ==In the manga== [[File:Saguaro Dendra Miriam Adventures.png|thumb|300px|Saguaro in [[Pokémon Adventures]]]] ===Pokémon Adventures=== Saguaro debuted in ''[[PASV02|Discover! The Quaking Earth Titan!!]]''. He and several other teachers were called to an emergency meeting by [[Clavell]] to discuss {{Violet}}, a new student that caused trouble during the Treasure Hunt's opening ceremony. Clavell informed the others of Violet's backstory and explained his behavior. In [[PASV25]], at [[Asado Desert]], Violet encountered Saguaro and [[Kofu]] during his and [[Arven]]'s battle with the dual Quaking Earth {{pkmn2|Titan}}s, {{p|Great Tusk}} and {{p|Iron Treads}}. Saguaro explained that he and Kofu were in the area after having helped rescue a worker at the [[Medali Gym|Treasure Eatery]] who had gone missing. Once Great Tusk was knocked out, Saguaro and Kofu lent their aid by keeping Iron Treads in place long enough for Violet and Arven to defeat it as well. The four then enjoyed sandwiches made from the [[Sour Herba Mystica]] that the two Titans were guarding. Later, [[Penny]] encountered Saguaro, [[Dendra]], and [[Miriam]] at the entrance hall of [[Uva Academy]]. Dendra tried getting Saguaro to try her sandwich made entirely of meat products despite Miriam's protests that it would result in severe stomach issues. Saguaro secretly preferred sweets, so he tried to pass the sandwich off to Penny, only for Miriam to help her escape by sending her out the building. ====Pokémon==== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Saguaro |pkmn=Hatterene |type1=Psychic |type2=Fairy |gender=female |img=Saguaro Hatterene Adventures.png |img_size=120px |epnum=PASV25 |epname= |desc={{p|Hatterene}} is Saguaro's first known Pokémon. She was first used alongside [[Kofu]]'s {{p|Wugtrio}} to assist {{Violet}} and [[Arven]] battle the {{pkmn2|Titan}} {{p|Iron Treads}}. She used her psychic abilities to keep Iron Treads from moving, giving Violet and Arven the opportunity to defeat it with a combined attack from their Pokémon. None of Hatterene's moves are known.}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Saguaro |pkmn=Pachirisu |type1=Electric |img=Saguaro Pachirisu Adventures.png |img_size=150px |epnum=Scarlet & Violet arc (Adventures) |epname=Scarlet & Violet arc |desc={{p|Pachirisu}} is Saguaro's second known Pokémon. It was first seen with its Trainer at the entrance of [[Uva Academy]]. While [[Dendra]] tried convincing Saguaro to try her all-meat sandwich, it was splashed by some of the meat's juices. None of Pachirisu's moves are known.}} {{-}} ==In the TCG== [[File:SaguaroPaldeaEvolved270.jpg|200px|thumb|Special illustration rare Saguaro]] {{main|Saguaro (Paldea Evolved 187)}} '''Saguaro''' was introduced as a {{TCG|Supporter card}} in the [[Pokémon Trading Card Game]] during the English Scarlet & Violet Series (the Japanese Scarlet & Violet Era). It was first released in the Japanese {{TCG|Clay Burst}} expansion and the English {{TCG|Paldea Evolved}} expansion, with artwork by [[nagimiso]]. An {{TCG|ultra rare}} version with artwork by the same artist, and a {{TCG|special illustration rare}} version of the card with artwork by [[Sanosuke Sakuma]] were released in the same sets.
